summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by CarMax Auto Funding LLC and related entities reporting an underwriting agreement for an asset-backed securitization. On June 9, 2026, CarMax Business Services and the depositor entered into an underwriting agreement with Wells Fargo Securities for $569,997,000 in various classes of asset-backed notes issued by CarMax Select Receivables Trust 2026-B. The offering includes Class A-1 notes ($90M), Class A-2 ($170.285M), Class A-3 ($170.285M), and Class B ($40.41M) notes. The transaction is a standard ABS issuance, not a special situation. No extraordinary corporate event, activist, or strategic change is present.
